name: Bases Filter Switches
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds free Pause and Resume controls for a filter group.
Corrects mixed list and scalar filters.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Pause beside a group takes its filters off, and Resume puts the same switches back. Both are free.
Pro switches made from property values now also match notes that have one value instead of a list.
tip: To turn a filter that the base already has into a switch, select the + button and pick it under "Use a filter of this base".
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Filter Switches is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
